title: Helixon Eval Result NDJSON
description: Line-delimited JSON contract emitted by helixon-eval and consumed by helixon-evolver. One JSON object per line; lines are whitespace-significant only as separators. See ADR-0008 (helixon-eval vs helixon-evolver separation) and IMP-001 (helixon-eval-evolver-ndjson-parity regression contract q8-c-10).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this contract. Bump MAJOR on breaking changes; MINOR on additive changes. Both repos must reject records with a higher MAJOR than they understand (see IMP-001 regression contract).

job_id.description: Globally unique eval job identifier. SHA-256 hex of (tenant_id, model_id, rubric_version, started_at). See v18688-3 (helixon-eval SHA-256 JobID cache).

eval_id.description: Per-attempt identifier. Distinct from job_id when the same job is re-run (retry, idempotency hit, partial requeue).

tenant_id.description: Tenant namespace. Required for cross-tenant isolation (v18688-4). helixon-evolver MUST refuse records whose tenant_id is not in its allow-list.

model_id.description: Identifier of the evaluated model. Format is implementation-defined (e.g. 'qwen3.6:32b-instruct-q5_k_m', 'openai/gpt-4o-mini-2026-07-15').

rubric_version.description: Version of the rubric registry used (per ADR-075).

started_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp marking the start of the eval attempt.

finished_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp marking the end of the eval attempt. Must be >= started_at.

status.description: Outcome of the eval attempt. 'success' means metrics are populated; 'error' means error.kind/error.message are populated.

metrics.description: Computed rubric metrics. Keys and value ranges are rubric-defined; values MUST be finite numbers.

artifacts.description: Optional artifact references (logs, traces, raw responses). Values are URIs resolvable by helixon-evolver.

trace_id.description: Optional OpenTelemetry-compatible trace id (32 hex chars). When present, helixon-evolver MUST correlate the eval into the EvoLoop cycle's trace span.

allOf.description: When status is 'success', metrics must be non-empty.
When status is anything other than 'success', error must be present.

$comment: Locked by helixon-eval-evolver-ndjson-parity regression contract (q8-c-10). See ADR-0008.
